messages:
elena: Quick handoff to runtime for the launch webinar. Need a minimal, reproducible bench bundle we can cite.

Asks: heatmap (coldstart vs steady), 50/95/99 per-request latencies, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens for fp16 vs quantized-int8. Include exact command and env.txt with commit + CUDA/driver info.

matt: Which model and matrix? Also want to know how many samples per cell.

elena: Model = redwood/3b-compat-v1 (prod-like). Matrix: batch 1 & 8, concurrency 1 & 16, seqlens 32/192/1024. 100-150 samples per cell is fine.

sophie: Marketing will publish one slide + short caveats. Include raw token counts so we can compute cost. If int8 shows instability at long context, capture stderr and flag the cell.

andy: Plan: 2 warmups, then 120 samples per cell. We'll capture 50/95/99, tokens/sec, GPU util, and any kernel warnings. We'll upload CSV, PNG heatmap, env.txt, and a README with a reproduce curl. Target: run tomorrow AM.

elena: Sample prompts: https://gist.example.com/redwood/webinar-samples (use "webinar-clean").

matt: I'll capture commit hash and kernel selection. We'll normalize charts to hosted fp16 baseline and include 95% CI where possible.

andy: Repro snippet for README:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RUNTIME_TOKEN' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood/3b-compat-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":64,"batch":1}'
```

bench-bot: Run queued: run_id=launch-evidence-5800-01. Logs: /internal/bench/runs/launch-evidence-5800-01. ETA ~3h.

matt: If int8 is flaky at 1024, we'll mark that cell unstable and provide conservative wording for the blog.

sophie: Deadline for artifacts: Fri 17:00 PT. If that's an issue, say so now.

andy: Aiming for Wed night artifacts so marketing can pick Thu morning. Will ping when artifacts ready.

elena: Thanks — please @matt and @andy on updates. Keep visuals minimal and reproducible.
